text_en: This is the ritual of the guilt offering. It is most holy;
text_cn: 赎过祭的法律如下：这是至圣之祭。

text_en: at the spot where the burnt offering is slaughtered, they shall slaughter the guilt offering, and its blood shall be dashed against all sides of the altar.
text_cn: 赎过祭牺牲应在宰杀全燔祭牺牲的地方宰杀，血应洒在祭坛的四周。

text_en: All its fat shall be offered: the broad tail, the fat that covers the entrails,
text_cn: 牺牲所有的一切脂肪都应献上，即油尾和遮盖内脏的脂肪，

text_en: the two kidneys with the fat that is on them at the loins, and the appendage of the liver, which shall be removed with the kidneys.
text_cn: 两肾和两肾上靠腰部的脂肪，以及同两肾一起取出的肝叶。

text_en: The priest shall turn them into smoke on the altar as an offering by fire to the Lord ; it is a guilt offering.
text_cn: 司祭应将这一切放在祭坛上焚烧，献与上主当作火祭：这是赎过祭。

text_en: Every male among the priests shall eat of it; it shall be eaten in a holy place; it is most holy.
text_cn: 至于祭肉，司祭家中，凡是男人都可以吃，应在圣处吃：这是至圣之物。

text_en: The guilt offering is like the sin offering, there is the same ritual for them; the priest who makes atonement with it shall have it.
text_cn: 关于赎过祭牺牲，像赎罪祭牺牲有同样的法律：应全归举行赎罪礼的司祭。

text_en: So, too, the priest who offers anyone’s burnt offering shall keep the skin of the burnt offering that he has offered.
text_cn: 代人奉献全燔祭的司祭，得享献作全燔祭牺牲的皮；

text_en: And every grain offering baked in the oven, and all that is prepared in a pan or on a griddle, shall belong to the priest who offers it.
text_cn: 凡在炉里烤的，或在锅里，或在烤盘上预备的素祭祭品，应归献此祭的司祭。

text_en: But every other grain offering, mixed with oil or dry, shall belong to all the sons of Aaron equally.
text_cn: 一切素祭祭品无论是调油的，或是干制的，全归亚郎的子孙彼此平分。

text_en: This is the ritual of the sacrifice of the offering of well-being that one may offer to the Lord .
text_cn: 献与上主和平祭的法律如下：

text_en: If you offer it for thanksgiving, you shall offer with the thank offering unleavened cakes mixed with oil, unleavened wafers spread with oil, and cakes of choice flour well soaked in oil.
text_cn: 若有人为感恩而献祭，除感恩祭祭品外，还应献上油调的无酵饼，抹油的无酵薄饼，以及用油和好细面做成的油饼。

text_en: With your thanksgiving sacrifice of well-being you shall bring your offering with cakes of leavened bread.
text_cn: 除这些饼以外，还应奉献发酵的饼作祭品，与感恩的和平祭品一同奉献。

text_en: From this you shall offer one cake from each offering, as a gift to the Lord ; it shall belong to the priest who dashes the blood of the offering of well-being.
text_cn: 由这些祭品中，每样应取出一份，献与上主作献仪：这一份应归那洒和平祭牲血的司祭。

text_en: And the flesh of your thanksgiving sacrifice of well-being shall be eaten on the day it is offered; you shall not leave any of it until morning.
text_cn: 为感恩所献的和平祭的祭肉，应在奉献的当日吃尽；不可留到次日早晨。

text_en: But if the sacrifice you offer is a votive offering or a freewill offering, it shall be eaten on the day that you offer your sacrifice, and what is left of it shall be eaten the next day;
text_cn: 如所献的牺牲是还愿祭或是自愿祭，在奉献的那天应该吃；如有剩下的，第二天也可吃；

text_en: but what is left of the flesh of the sacrifice shall be burned up on the third day.
text_cn: 如还有剩下的祭肉，到第三天应用火烧了。

text_en: If any of the flesh of your sacrifice of well-being is eaten on the third day, it shall not be acceptable, nor shall it be credited to the one who offers it; it shall be an abomination, and the one who eats of it shall incur guilt.
text_cn: 若在第三天还吃和平祭祭肉，祭献必不被悦纳；为奉献的人，也不算作祭献，因为肉已不洁；吃的人，必负罪债。

text_en: Flesh that touches any unclean thing shall not be eaten; it shall be burned up. As for other flesh, all who are clean may eat such flesh.
text_cn: 祭肉若接触了不洁之物，不许再吃，应用火焚烧；凡洁净的人可吃祭肉；

text_en: But those who eat flesh from the Lord ’s sacrifice of well-being while in a state of uncleanness shall be cut off from their kin.
text_cn: 但是染有不洁的人，若吃了献与上主和平祭的祭肉，这人应由民间铲除。

text_en: When any one of you touches any unclean thing—human uncleanness or an unclean animal or any unclean creature—and then eats flesh from the Lord ’s sacrifice of well-being, you shall be cut off from your kin.
text_cn: 若有人接触了任何不洁，或不洁的人，或不洁的禽兽，或任何不洁之物，而吃了献与上主和平祭的祭肉，这人应由民间铲除。”

text_en: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟说：

text_en: Speak to the people of Israel, saying: You shall eat no fat of ox or sheep or goat.
text_cn: “你告诉以色列子民说：凡是牛、绵羊和山羊的脂肪，你们都不可吃。

text_en: The fat of an animal that died or was torn by wild animals may be put to any other use, but you must not eat it.
text_cn: 自死或被野兽撕裂的走兽的脂肪，可作任何用途，但决不可吃。

text_en: If any one of you eats the fat from an animal of which an offering by fire may be made to the Lord , you who eat it shall be cut off from your kin.
text_cn: 不论谁，若吃了能献与上主作火祭的牲畜的脂肪，吃的人就应由民间铲除。

text_en: You must not eat any blood whatever, either of bird or of animal, in any of your settlements.
text_cn: 在你们任何所居之地，凡是血，不论是鸟血或兽血，决不可吃。

text_en: Any one of you who eats any blood shall be cut off from your kin.
text_cn: 不论谁，若吃了什么血，这人应由民间铲除。”

text_en: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟说：

text_en: Speak to the people of Israel, saying: Any one of you who would offer to the Lord your sacrifice of well-being must yourself bring to the Lord your offering from your sacrifice of well-being.
text_cn: “你告诉以色列子民说：凡向上主奉献和平祭祭品的，应由和平祭祭品取出一部分，作为献于上主的供物。

text_en: Your own hands shall bring the Lord ’s offering by fire; you shall bring the fat with the breast, so that the breast may be raised as an elevation offering before the Lord .
text_cn: 亲手带来献与上主的火祭，即带来脂肪和胸脯；胸脯应在上主前行奉献的摇礼。

text_en: The priest shall turn the fat into smoke on the altar, but the breast shall belong to Aaron and his sons.
text_cn: 司祭将脂肪放在祭坛上焚烧，胸脯归于亚郎和他的儿子。

text_en: And the right thigh from your sacrifices of well-being you shall give to the priest as an offering;
text_cn: 和平祭牺牲的后右腿，你们应送给司祭作献仪。

text_en: the one among the sons of Aaron who offers the blood and fat of the offering of well-being shall have the right thigh for a portion.
text_cn: 亚郎子孙中谁奉献了和平祭牺牲的血和脂肪，右后腿应归于他，是他的一分。

text_en: For I have taken the breast of the elevation offering, and the thigh that is offered, from the people of Israel, from their sacrifices of well-being, and have given them to Aaron the priest and to his sons, as a perpetual due from the people of Israel.
text_cn: 因为我由以色列子民所献的和平祭中，取出当摇献的胸脯和当举献的右后腿，给了亚郎司祭和他的儿子，作为他们在以色列子民中永享的权利”。

text_en: This is the portion allotted to Aaron and to his sons from the offerings made by fire to the Lord , once they have been brought forward to serve the Lord as priests;
text_cn: 这是亚郎和他的儿子，在受命为上主尽司祭职的那一天，因受傅由献与上主的火祭中应得的一分；

text_en: these the Lord commanded to be given them, when he anointed them, as a perpetual due from the people of Israel throughout their generations.
text_cn: 是上主在他们受傅的那一天，吩咐以色列子民应交给他们的一分：这是他们世世代代永享的权利。

text_en: This is the ritual of the burnt offering, the grain offering, the sin offering, the guilt offering, the offering of ordination, and the sacrifice of well-being,
text_cn: 以上是关于全燔祭、素祭、赎罪祭、赎过祭、祝圣祭及和平祭的法律。

text_en: which the Lord commanded Moses on Mount Sinai, when he commanded the people of Israel to bring their offerings to the Lord , in the wilderness of Sinai.
text_cn: 这些法律是上主在他命令以色列子民，于西乃旷野给上主奉献祭品的那天，在西乃山上向梅瑟所咐吩的。
